rows.title: Karlobag, 2 May 1774 — Vincentius Smojver «Vukich» and Oliva, daughter of the late Caetanus Bacchi
rows.where: image 306, right-hand page: headed 1773, then «Anno Dni 1774»; the entry is the one with «Maij» in the left margin, the second under the 1774 heading
rows.says: «Praemissis praemittendis et habito mutuo consensu Vincentii filii Josephi Smojver, vulgo nuncupati Vukich, ac Olivae filiae defti Caetani Bacchi, eos per verba de praesenti solemniter matrimonio conjunxi, praesentibus Dno Nicolao Jurich et Francisco [Lukulich?]». The year is read from the heading above; the witnesses at one zoom.

rows.title: Karlobag, 20 October 1760 — Paulus Perpich marries Anna, widow of Caetanus Bachi
rows.where: image 293, left-hand page, headed «Anno Domini 1760»; the entry is the second of 20 October, the one beginning «Idem eadem die»
rows.says: «Idem eadem die matrimonialiter copulavi Paulum Perpich et Annam viduam Caetani Bachi. Praesentibus testibus Joanno Mat[hosich] ac Petro Bevandich». Shows a Caetanus Bacchi dead by October 1760; probably the elder Caetanus (ahnentafel 214) — not proved.

people.name: Anna, widow of Caetanus Bacchi (married Paulus Perpich)

rows.title: Karlobag, 4 February 1753 — Caetanus Bachi marries Anna, daughter of the late Alexius Lukatelli
rows.where: image 287, right-hand page: «Anno Domini 1752», then «Anno Domini 1753»; the entry is the last on the page, «Idem eadem die» after the 4 February entry
rows.says: «Idem eadem die matrimonialiter copulavi ad faciem Ecclesiae Cajetanum Bachi et Annam filiam defuncti Alexij Lukatelli. Praesentibus Wolffgango Suvich ac Joanne Radkovich». The father's surname is read from the full page.

people.name: Anna, daughter of the late Alexius Lukatelli (wife of Caetanus Bacchi)

rows.title: Karlobag, 22 November 1747 — Jakov Pilepich marries Katta, daughter of the late Vicko Luckinich
rows.where: image 283, right-hand page, headed «Letta 1747»: the entry dated «Dan 22: Novembra», second from the foot of the 1747 block (Croatian text)
rows.says: Croatian entry of the priest Andrij Kollekar joining «Jakova Lillepicha» (Pilepich) and «Kattu», the daughter «heer pokoif Vicka fucki[nicha]» — read as «daughter of the late Vicko Luckinich». The surnames are read at about 4x and are the least certain words.

rows.title: Karlobag, 2 November 1785 — Michael Gerkacs and Lucia, daughter of Paul Tomljanovic of Montani Stanize
rows.where: image 324, right-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1785»: the third entry, in the left margin «2 Novemb»
rows.says: «… matrimonio conjunxi ego Joes Antonius Ivankovich Parochus … Michaelis filij defti Nicolai Gergacs et Luciae Pauli Tomljenovich Loci Mostani [Montani] Stanize». Gives the groom's late father (ahnentafel 220) and the bride's father (222).

rows.title: Karlobag, 14 February 1798 — Josephus Pilepich (widower) and Maria, daughter of Vincentius (probable)
rows.where: image 343, right-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1798»: the second entry, in the left margin «14 Febr[uarij]»
rows.says: «… Josephi viduei [Pilepich?] et Mariae filiae Vincenti [Smojver?] …». Date, both first names and the father's given name fit; both surnames are faint, so the identification as ahnentafel 52 and 53 is probable, not proved.

rows.title: Karlobag, 5 February 1755 — Matthias Kriskovich marries Magdalena, daughter of Dominicus Uroda
rows.where: image 289, right-hand page: «Anno Domini 1754», then «1755»; the entry is the last on the page, «Die 5ta Febr»
rows.says: «Matthiam Kriskovich et Magdalenam filiam Dominici Uroda. Praesentibus Nicolao Perpich ac Josepho Venerando». A Dominicus Uroda with a daughter marrying in 1755; not shown to be related to Georgius Uroda (ahnentafel 108).

people.name: Magdalena, daughter of Dominicus Uroda (wife of Matthias Kriskovich)

rows.title: Karlobag, 13 November 1767 — a man of Senj marries Maria, daughter of the late Dominicus Uroda
rows.where: image 300, right-hand page, headed «Anno Dni 1767»: the second entry, in the left margin «13 9bris»
rows.says: «… conjunxi Joannem [? underlined word] Senicensem et Mariam filiam defuncti Dominici Uroda, praesentibus testibus …». The groom's given name is read as Joannes (an earlier note of this archive said Josephus; the page reads Joannem, with an underlined word after it). Shows Dominicus Uroda dead by November 1767.

rows.title: Karlobag, 1748 — «Dominico Uroda» a witness at marriages (3, 5 October and 17 November)
rows.where: image 284, left-hand page, headed «Anno Domini 1748»: the entries of 3 and 5 October and 17 November each end «… et Dominico Uroda»
rows.says: Dominicus «Dume» Uroda appears as witness about ten times between 1744 and 1749; this page shows three. He was an adult Karlobag man by 1744 and dead by 1767. He may be the father of Georgius Uroda (ahnentafel 108); nothing read says so.

rows.title: Karlobag, 13 April 1725 — Ana, daughter of Vicko Luckinich and his wife Mare
rows.where: image 47, left-hand page, in the viewer's numbering (about book page 31): the entries of April 1725 are written near the foot, out of date order
rows.says: «Na 13 Aprilya 1725 Ja Pop Andrij Kollekar karstih [k]… Vicka Luckinicha, nyegove xene mare imen[om] Anu koy bi kum Sg. Karlo Slayner …». Read as a daughter Ana to Vicko and Mare; the index and the tree make «Mare» the child. The same page carries the godfather entry of 1724.

people.name: Ana, daughter of Vicko Luckinich and Mare (read «Anu»)

rows.title: Karlobag, 18 March 1753 — «Caietan Bachi» and his wife Anna as sponsors
rows.where: image 117, right-hand page, in the viewer's numbering (book page 211), headed «Letta 1753»: the entry «Dan 18: Marca» near the foot
rows.says: A baptism of a child of Petar Tomljenovich «Bihu kumi Caietan Bachi, svojom xenom Annom» — Caetanus with his wife Anna, six weeks after their wedding. Read at about 4x.

rows.title: Karlobag, early January 1754 — Silvester, son of Gaetanus and Anne Bachi
rows.where: image 119, right-hand page, in the viewer's numbering (book page 215), headed «Letta 1754»: the second entry under «Dan 1 Genvara» (dated 2 or 3 January)
rows.says: «… krstih Antola [Antonu?] Sylvestra sina Gajetana y Anne Bachi. Bihu kumi Jose y Venera Dur[…]ch». The first name is read at one zoom.

people.name: Silvester, son of Gaetanus and Anna Bachi

rows.title: Selce, 18 October 1798 — Joannes Antić and Martha Lončarić
rows.where: image 248, left-hand page, headed «Anno 1798»: the second entry, numbered 27 in the margin
rows.says: Latin entry of the chaplain Michael Kombol: «… Joannem filium defuncti Antonii et Ursulae Antich cum Martha filia Pauli et Annae Lonchasich», witnesses Mathia Jellichich and Georgio Antich. Names both sets of parents (ahnentafel 96–99).

rows.title: Selce, 14 October 1800 — Georgius Jelličić and Margaretha Drozović
rows.where: image 251, left-hand page, «Die 14 8bris Ao 1800»: the fourth entry, numbered 96 in the margin
rows.says: «… Georgium filium Mathiae et Margaritae Jellichich cum Margareta filia Joannis et Catharinae Drozovich, praesentibus Laurentio Allegri? et Joanne Drozovich». The bride's surname reads DROZOVICH, not the tree's Brozović. Names both sets of parents (ahnentafel 100–103).

rows.title: Kranj–Šmartin, 3 December 1775 — Franciscus Xaverius Kosina, son of Lucas and Helena (probably Franz Kosinar)
rows.film: Krstna knjiga Kranj–Šmartin 1747–1779 (Nadškofijski arhiv Ljubljana, Matricula sig. 00883)
rows.where: page 330, right-hand page: the second row, day «3», baptiser «Zeller», locus «S. Thomae» with the number 10
rows.says: Infans «Koskina Franciscus Xaverius», parents «Lucas et Helena Kosarsa [Kosina]», «Domus Paroch. Local», S. Thomae 10. The year is read from the heading «1776 Januarij» two pages on. Probable, not proved, to be the Franz Kosinar who died 1849.

people.name: Franciscus Xaverius Kosina, son of Lucas and Helena

rows.title: Karlobag, 10 April 1778 — Jacobus Pilepich, captain of the port, buried in his own crypt
rows.where: image 364, right-hand page (folio 17), headed «Anno Dni 1778»: the entry in the margin «10 Aprilis»
rows.says: «D. Jacobus Pilepich Capitaneus portûs, munitus omnibus Sacramentis per M.R. D. Andream Pintor Capellanum Loci, spiritum Deo reddidit … in propria Crypta in Parochiali Ecclesia existente … tumulatus est». Ahnentafel 104's death.

rows.title: Karlobag, 16 May 1776 — Josephus Smojver, called Vukcich, aged 45
rows.where: image 361, right-hand page (folio 11), headed «Anno Dni 1776»: the second entry under «Maij»
rows.says: «Josephus Smojver dictus Vukcich, annorum 45, munitus omnibus Sacramentis obiit in Domino atque die 17 … tumulatus est». Ahnentafel 212's death; the age puts his birth about 1731.

rows.title: Karlobag, 30 October 1783 — Nicolaus Gergacs, aged 66, died in his son Antonius's house
rows.where: image 376, right-hand page (folio 39), headed «Anno Dni 1783»: the entry «30 8bris»
rows.says: «Nicolaus Gergacs annorum 66, munitus omnibus sacramentis obiit in domo filij sui Antonij, et die 31 ejusdem sepultus est in Cemeterio laterali». Ahnentafel 220's death.

rows.title: Karlobag, 29 May 1790 — Catharina, aged 70, widow of the late Jacob Pilepich
rows.where: image 388, right-hand page (folio 63), headed «Anno Domini 1790»: the entry «29 ejusdem [Maij]», the last but one on the page
rows.says: «Catharina annorum 70 vidua defti Dni Capitanei Jacobi Pilepich obiit in Domino munita omnibus sacramentis, atque die 30 sepulta est». Ahnentafel 105's death; the age 70 puts her birth about 1720, which no baptism of 1717–1732 supports.

rows.title: Karlobag, 10 September 1791 — Dominus Georgius Uroda, buried in his own crypt (no age given)
rows.where: image 390, right-hand page (folio 67), headed «Anno Domini 1791»: the entry «10 ejusdem» under September, near the foot
rows.says: «Dñus Georgius Uroda, munitus omnibus Sacramentis, in domo sua obiit, atque die 12 sepultus est in propria sua Cripta ante fores Ecclesiae Parochialis existente». NO AGE is given, and no occupation. Ahnentafel 108's death.

rows.title: Karlobag, 19 September 1809 — Lucia, called Maja, wife of Michael Gergacs, aged 34
rows.where: image 125, left-hand page (page 12), headed «Annus Domini 1809»: the entry «19 [Sept]», fourth from the foot
rows.says: «Lucia, vulgo Maja, uxor Michaelis Gergacs, annorum 34, provisa omnibus sacramentis obiit in Domino, atque in propria crypta … humata est». Ahnentafel 111's death; an age of 34 cannot fit a marriage of 1785 and a daughter of 1789, so her age stays unresolved.

rows.title: Karlobag, 28 June 1828 — Josephus Pilepich, aged 61
rows.where: image 138, right-hand page (page 35), headed «Anno Domini 1828»: the entry of 28 June (margin «Junii»), about the fifth from the top
rows.says: «… Josephus Pilepich Carlobagensis annorum 61 in communione S. Matris Ecclesiae animam Deo reddidit, cujus corpus die 29 h. sepultum est in coemeterio S. Caroli». Ahnentafel 52's death, found through the book's index (KAZALO). The page is dense Latin and read at about 3x.

rows.title: Karlobag, 6 August 1834 — Maria, wife of the fisherman Georgius Uroda, aged 45
rows.where: image 149, right-hand page (folio 52), headed «Anno Domini 1834»: an entry in the upper half of the page, among those of July–August
rows.says: «Maria uxor piscatoris Georgii Uroda annorum 45 …», died 6 August 1834 and buried the 7th. Ahnentafel 55's death (née Gerkacs, married 1807); it names her husband, ahnentafel 54, as a fisherman, still alive. The entry is small and was read at about 4x; find it by the word «piscatoris».

rows.title: Karlobag, March 1781 — Oliva Maria, daughter of Vincentius Smojver «Vukich» and Oliva
rows.where: image 217, right-hand page (book page 65), headed «Anno Domini 1781»: the seventh entry, margin «Ejusdem» under March
rows.says: «Ego Joes Antonius Ivankovich Parochus Loci baptizavi infantem natam ex Vincentio et Oliva Smoyver, vulgo Vukich, Conjugibus hujus Civitatis, cui impositum est nomen Oliva Maria». Ahnentafel 53's baptism; the parents are 106 and 107, married 7 years earlier (see the 1774 marriage).

rows.title: Karlobag, 21–22 April 1777 — Joannes Georgius, son of Georgius Uroda and Maria
rows.where: image 202, right-hand page (book page 37), headed «Anno Dni 1777»: the entry under the margin «Aprilis», second from the foot («Ego Joes Antius … ex Georgio et Maria Uroda … Joannis Georgij»)
rows.says: «Ego Joes Antius Ivankovich Parochus Loci baptizavi Infantem … ex Georgio et Maria Uroda Conjugibus hujus Loci, cui impositum est nomen Joannis Georgij». Ahnentafel 54's baptism, naming his parents (108 and 109); the godfather is a colonel. Read at about 3x.
